Capacity/revision failures record their cause and spend jobs.attempts up to USP_JOB_LIMITS.maxAttempts=3.
A successful claim resets that counter through existing attempt authority; no fenced attempt is spent waiting.
Pending child readers record TABLE_READ_PENDING without spending admission retries. No age-based failure.
